name: bluefairy/module-jira-hyva
description: Hyvä storefront templates for BlueFairy Jira Integration

suggest.bluefairy/module-jira-graph-ql: REQUIRED for this storefront to work. Both templates here do every read and every write through GraphQL operations declared only in that package; without it the pages render and silently do nothing (M2MAP-401). The base package's GraphQlAvailability view model makes the absence visible on the page rather than silent.
